item.text: {"primary_intent":"generate","brief_class":"concept_to_production","execution_status":"not_executed","workflow_steps":[{"id":"intake_brief","objective":"Confirm business goal, recipients, contents, quantity, budget, timing, brand inputs, mandatory copy, distribution route, manufacturing constraints, approval owners and measurable success criteria."},{"id":"research","objective":"Review Mid-Autumn cultural context, recipient expectations, relevant market conventions, competitor packaging, accessibility, sustainability opportunities and converter capabilities without deriving a style from the published reference."},{"id":"principles","objective":"Agree decision principles for cultural appropriateness, brand recognition, gifting impact, unboxing sequence, product protection, material efficiency, finish restraint and manufacturability."},{"id":"process_model","objective":"Define responsibilities, approval gates, vendor engineering reviews, proof and sample rounds, test criteria, change control and release authority before design development."},{"id":"explore_concepts","objective":"Develop meaningfully different structural, opening, presentation, graphic and finish directions, each accompanied by indicative materials, risks, cost tier and production implications."},{"id":"select_direction","objective":"Compare concepts against the agreed principles, feasibility and budget, then obtain explicit client and manufacturer approval for one direction and its permitted refinements."},{"id":"structure_spec","objective":"Engineer the selected package architecture, including dimensions, component hierarchy, insert retention, closure, board or substrate assumptions, tolerances, assembly, packing, stacking and transport requirements."},{"id":"identity_system","objective":"Define the edition-specific surface-art system—information hierarchy, typography, colour, imagery or motifs, placement and finish logic—within the supplied master-brand rules."},{"id":"dieline","objective":"Create component-level cutting, creasing, folding, glue and artwork geometry based on the approved structure and the nominated manufacturer's technical standards."},{"id":"prototype_test","objective":"Produce and assess structural mockups, product-fit samples, decorated prototypes and finish strike-offs; test opening, retention, assembly, stacking, transit protection, legibility and finish registration as applicable."},{"id":"refine","objective":"Resolve feedback and test findings in the approved direction, updating structure, artwork, materials and finishes while documenting any effects on cost, timing or feasibility."},{"id":"production_file","objective":"Prepare preflighted manufacturing masters with separations, bleeds, overprints, spot colours, white ink, foil, emboss or deboss, varnish, coating and assembly specifications aligned to the approved vendor template."}],"reference_observations":[{"asset_id":"BRF-PACK-06-reference-1","observations":["The portrait image visibly presents two pale circular or cylindrical lidded packages, with one balanced upright above another positioned horizontally.","The upright face contains concentric circular detailing, a thin red ring, a small central emblem and faint perimeter or face markings; the lower package shows uppercase text including “MOONLIGHT DREAMS.”","Fine raised, recessed or textured-looking marks are visible across the pale package surfaces, while directional light and shadow describe the round edges and depth.","Red textured organic forms sit above the package, translucent red and pink curved sheets occupy the right side, and a large diffuse white orb appears at upper left against a warm gradient background.","As published-outcome evidence, the image demonstrates that structural form, face and side artwork, apparent surface finishes and presentation imagery may all belong to the final deliverable set; it does not establish a required style, material, construction method or hidden design process."]}],"deliverable_concepts":["packaging_family","structural_packaging","production_spec","mockups","brand_applications","dieline","prototype"],"missing_inputs":["Product types, counts, dimensions, weights, fragility, shelf life and required arrangement inside the box.","Target recipients, market, sales or gifting channel, price position, production quantity and success criteria.","Brand guidelines, approved logo files, campaign or edition naming, mandatory copy, languages, imagery and asset rights.","Required legal, origin, recycling, safety, food-contact, traceability or other regulatory markings, with responsible approvers.","Launch date, manufacturing and delivery milestones, sampling allowance and final artwork deadline.","Target unit cost, tooling budget, prototype budget and acceptable cost variance.","Nominated printer or converter, production location, equipment limits, preferred substrates, available stock thicknesses, colour profiles and dieline standards.","Sustainability requirements, restricted materials, recyclability targets, certifications and disposal guidance.","Shipping carton, pallet, storage, retail-display, stacking, humidity and transit-test requirements.","Desired or prohibited finishes, tactile requirements, colour standards, registration tolerances and acceptable substitutions.","Required components such as insert, tray, sleeve, closure, handle, card, envelope or protective wrap.","Approval stakeholders, procurement responsibilities, number of revision rounds, required file formats and handoff conventions."],"assumptions":["The scope is one coordinated Mid-Autumn gift-box system for one primary market; additional sizes or SKUs require separate confirmation.","The packaged products already exist and product development itself is outside scope.","An existing master brand and approved core identity will be supplied; a new logo or full rebrand is not assumed.","The package may include an outer box and necessary internal retention components, but the final component count depends on confirmed contents and unboxing requirements.","A qualified printer or packaging converter will review dimensions, tolerances, materials, finishes and tooling before production release.","“Producible package” means validated, manufacturer-aligned production assets and specifications; procurement and mass manufacture are not assumed to be completed.","Client or legal representatives will supply and approve all claims, translations, regulatory copy and licensed assets.","Cultural symbols and imagery will be original or properly licensed and reviewed for appropriateness.","The reference is used only to understand the category of published outcome and will not be copied or treated as a visual direction."],"stop_conditions":["Do not lock structure or begin final dielines until physical product samples or authoritative dimensions, arrangement, protection needs and distribution constraints are confirmed.","Do not advance a concept into detailed engineering without explicit client selection and preliminary converter feasibility review.","Pause prototype procurement if quantity, budget, vendor, substrate availability, finish capability or sampling responsibility remains unresolved.","Do not finalize artwork until approved brand assets, mandatory copy, translations, legal markings and asset rights are complete.","Do not release production masters until the nominated manufacturer has approved the dieline, tolerances, separations, colour setup, substrates, finishes and assembly method.","Do not deliver files as production-ready until product-fit and structural testing, decorated proof or finish strike-offs, preflight and stakeholder approvals meet the agreed acceptance criteria.","Any post-approval change to contents, dimensions, material, finish, copy, vendor or shipping route requires impact assessment and revalidation before release."],"rationale":"This is classified as concept_to_production because the requested outcome extends beyond visual exploration into structural decisions, finish feasibility, dielines, prototypes, testing and manufacturer-aligned production masters. The workflow therefore uses explicit client and converter gates before irreversible tooling or production release, while treating the supplied image solely as evidence of the kinds of finished packaging outcomes that may need presentation and technical resolution.","confidence":0.97}
